title: Simplify KP around the animation catalogue
summary: Implement the approved asset-first catalogue, perfect the solve-x shell exemplar first, stop for human review before generalization, then inventory concrete assets and derive the canonical port queue.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved catalogue-first product and architecture decision.
Approved exemplar-first implementation plan and human checkpoint.
Living catalogue scope, boundaries, and current next action.

expectedLearning: Which registry is the smallest truthful authority for concrete loadable catalogue identity.
Which existing adapters can host assets without iframe or renderer changes, and where hostability gaps actually lie.
Whether the approved solve-x shell remains simple under one structurally different caller after human approval.
Which human dispositions and high-information seams should determine the canonical port queue.
allowedWork: Execute only run-contract.kp.animation-catalogue-simplification-v1 within its stored slice order, checkpoint, preservation boundary, and stop conditions.
disallowedWork: Do not generalize visual treatment before human approval or begin economics, public-site, curriculum, broad LLM editorial, universal renderer, or unrelated dashboard work.
